name: dev
description: The iteration set: nine cases anchored on the official grid's center point (B=64, S=128, d=128, H=4, ffn=128, L=4, causal -- every official shape is causal, so causal is the default here too). Five cases probe the grid's own extremes, four probe the axes the appendix table leaves to script flags (dtype, padding, scale). Cheap enough to run after every candidate; promote nothing on dev alone -- re-run bench/shapes/official.json before recording a headline number.

cases.name: center
cases.note: The official grid's center point. 8192 tokens, ~0.4M params, ffn = d_model. Launch-bound.

cases.name: center-bf16
cases.note: dtype is a script flag, not a grid column. Checks the tolerance budget survives bf16 -- the case that separates fused-safe from fused-sdpa.

cases.name: center-fp16
cases.note: fp16: wider mantissa than bf16, narrower dynamic range.

cases.name: center-padded
cases.note: padding_ratio is a script flag. Three output-masking sites become live; a naive SDPA swap silently fails here.

cases.name: batch-1
cases.note: The latency floor: 128 tokens, per-launch overhead is most of the wall clock.

cases.name: batch-128
cases.note: The large-batch end that still iterates quickly (batch-10000 lives in the official set only).

cases.name: wide-1024
cases.note: head_dim = 256, the flash upper limit; the compute-heavy end of the width sweep.

cases.name: heads-16
cases.note: head_dim = 8, the fused-backend lower edge -- measure which backend actually serves it.

cases.name: seq-1024
cases.note: Attention goes O(S^2)-dominant. The stress-100k regime's nearest cheap proxy.
